d.ko: Help a wizard build and upgrade a wizard tower in this incremental game! Use the tower to study magic, summon spirits, create buildings, and influence the world.
d.en: Help a wizard build and upgrade a wizard tower in this incremental game! Use the tower to study magic, summon spirits, create buildings, and influence the world.
d.zh: 在这款放置增量游戏中，帮助法师建造并升级法师塔！利用高塔研究魔法、召唤精灵、修建塔楼，并影响整个世界。
